# Aruba Networks
> Aruba Networks, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company, provides enterprise networking, Wi‑Fi, switching, SD‑WAN, security, and network management solutions.

This site includes product documentation, software release notes, technical support resources, APIs, training, and solution information for Aruba enterprise networking platforms.

## Documentation
- [Aruba Support Portal](https://asp.arubanetworks.com/): Central hub for Aruba product documentation, software downloads, and support resources.
- [Documentation Center](https://asp.arubanetworks.com/downloads): Browse Aruba manuals, guides, release notes, and software by product family.
- [ArubaOS 10 Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/ArubaOS_10.x/): Official documentation for ArubaOS 10 deployment, configuration, and operations.
- [ArubaOS 8 Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/ArubaOS_8.x/): Documentation for ArubaOS 8 controllers, gateways, and wireless infrastructure.
- [AOS-CX Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/AOS-CX/): Switch operating system documentation for Aruba CX switching platforms.
- [Instant and Instant On Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/Instant/): Documentation for Aruba Instant wireless access points and clusters.
- [Aruba Central Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/central/latest/content/home.htm): Cloud management documentation for Aruba Central features and workflows.

## API and Developer
- [Aruba Developer Hub](https://developer.arubanetworks.com/): Developer portal for Aruba APIs, SDKs, sample code, and integration resources.
- [Aruba Central APIs](https://developer.arubanetworks.com/aruba-central/reference/overview): API reference for Aruba Central automation and integrations.
- [AOS-CX API Guide](https://developer.arubanetworks.com/aoscx/docs): Developer documentation for AOS-CX programmability and REST APIs.
- [Network Analytics Engine](https://developer.arubanetworks.com/aoscx/docs/getting-started-with-nae): Guidance for using AOS-CX Network Analytics Engine and scripts.
- [Aruba Central Postman Collections](https://developer.arubanetworks.com/aruba-central/docs/getting-started-with-postman): Postman-based onboarding for Aruba Central API exploration.
- [Developer Workshops](https://developer.arubanetworks.com/workshops): Hands-on labs and workshops for Aruba automation and programmability.

## Software and Release Notes
- [Software Downloads](https://asp.arubanetworks.com/downloads/software): Aruba software images, patches, and related downloadable packages.
- [Release Notes Search](https://asp.arubanetworks.com/downloads;products=Aruba%20Access%20Points): Product-specific access to release notes and software artifacts.
- [ArubaOS 10 Release Notes](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/ArubaOS_10.x/Consolidated_8.x_RN/Content/home.htm): Release information, fixes, and known issues for ArubaOS 10.
- [AOS-CX Release Notes](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/AOS-CX/10.14/RN/Content/home.htm): Release notes for AOS-CX switch software versions and updates.
- [Aruba Central Release Notes](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/central/latest/content/release_notes/release-notes.htm): Cloud platform release notes for Aruba Central services and features.

## Product Documentation
- [Access Points Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/hardware/accesspoints/): Hardware installation and reference documentation for Aruba access points.
- [Gateways Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/hardware/gateways/): Hardware guides for Aruba gateways and branch networking appliances.
- [Switches Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/hardware/switches/): Hardware installation and reference guides for Aruba switching platforms.
- [Aruba Central Online Help](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/central/latest/content/home.htm): Feature documentation for cloud-based network management and operations.
- [AirWave Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/AirWave/): Documentation for Aruba AirWave network management software.
- [ClearPass Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/ClearPass/6.11/PolicyManager/Content/home.htm): Documentation for Aruba ClearPass policy management and network access control.
- [User Experience Insight Documentation](https://www.arubanetworks.com/techdocs/UXI/): Documentation for Aruba User Experience Insight monitoring and analytics.

## Support and Services
- [Support Portal Home](https://asp.arubanetworks.com/): Access support cases, downloads, documentation, and lifecycle resources.
- [Contact Support](https://asp.arubanetworks.com/contact-support): Aruba support contact options and service request information.
- [Warranty and Support Services](https://www.arubanetworks.com/support-services/): Information about Aruba support offerings, warranties, and service programs.
- [Product Security Advisories](https://www.arubanetworks.com/support-services/security-bulletins/): Security bulletins and advisories for Aruba products and software.
- [End of Life Information](https://www.arubanetworks.com/support-services/end-of-life/): Lifecycle and end-of-sale or end-of-support notices for Aruba products.
- [Licensing](https://asp.arubanetworks.com/downloads;fileTypes=LICENSE): Licensing-related downloads and entitlement resources.

## Training and Certification
- [Aruba Education Services](https://www.arubanetworks.com/support-services/training-services/): Training programs, learning paths, and education services for Aruba technologies.
- [Certification Program](https://www.arubanetworks.com/support-services/training-services/certification/): Aruba certification tracks and credential information.

- [Digital Learning](https://www.arubanetworks.com/support-services/training-services/digital-learning/): Self-paced learning options for Aruba networking products and solutions.

## Solutions and Architecture
- [Solutions Overview](https://www.arubanetworks.com/solutions/): Aruba solution pages for campus, branch, data center, and remote work.
- [Enterprise Networking](https://www.arubanetworks.com/products/networking/): Overview of Aruba networking product families and deployment areas.
- [Wireless Access](https://www.arubanetworks.com/products/wireless/access-points/): Aruba wireless access point portfolio and related solution context.
- [Switching](https://www.arubanetworks.com/products/switches/): Aruba switching portfolio for campus, branch, and data center environments.
- [SD-WAN and SASE](https://www.arubanetworks.com/products/sd-wan/): Aruba edge connectivity and secure access service edge solutions.
- [Network Security](https://www.arubanetworks.com/products/security/): Aruba security products including NAC, zero trust, and policy enforcement.
- [Network Management](https://www.arubanetworks.com/products/network-management-operations/): Aruba management and operations platforms for visibility and control.
